findings.summary: A branch_pr review can silently fall back to root-commit evidence when no base reference is available and the evaluated commit has no parent.
findings.broken_invariant: Branch_pr evaluator preparation must fail closed with E_VALIDATION whenever the authoritative diff base cannot be resolved; returning null permits renderActualDiff to use git show --root instead.

missing_tests: Add a branch_pr regression test where base resolution yields no reference and evaluated_sha is a root commit; evaluator preparation must fail with E_VALIDATION rather than freezing git show --root output.
hidden_assumptions: The implementation assumes that an evaluated root commit without a resolved base is a legitimate no-base case, although the approved branch_pr contract requires unresolved bases to fail closed.
recovery_context: Change branch_pr base resolution so every non-null evaluated SHA requires a resolved merge base, including root commits, while retaining root/single-commit fallback only for non-branch_pr workflows; add the missing root-commit branch_pr regression test.
